hook: Cornstarch beats baking powder for crispy air fryer wings

social_media_package.caption_opening: Cornstarch, not baking powder. That's the difference between "pretty crispy" and shatter-crisp air fryer wings.
social_media_package.cta: Want more air fryer recipes? Get the app through the link in my bio.
